scope: Existing Design Manager route #page/home_normal_v1/hifi/multi_screen_static_hifi. These rules define the browser candidate composition only and do not change Android Runtime or the frozen A/B/C runtime allocation.

hero.when_minimum_does_not_fit: Keep Hero at the minimum size and allow local vertical scrolling within FishCatchPager; do not overlap Header, Stats, title, Footer or safe bounds.

pager.indicator_semantics: Generated illustrative pager state only; does not represent live FishRecord count or navigation.

capture_action_group.cta_layout_height_formula: measured CTA line-height = rendered font size * 1.25
capture_action_group.footer_padding_and_gap: Use existing contract values once; never stack artwork and touch target vertically.

vertical_allocation.safe_insets_owner: layout calculator; subtract top and bottom inset exactly once
vertical_allocation.fixed_content: Measure Header, Stats, RecentCatchHeader, and CaptureActionGroup from their own contract-derived content bounds before calculating pager space.
vertical_allocation.base_inter_group_gaps: Reuse existing stats_to_title and card_to_footer formulas.
vertical_allocation.long_screen_remainder: After Hero reaches target size and added A/B and B/C gaps reach their caps, split remaining space equally as outer top and bottom breathing margins.
vertical_allocation.short_screen_behavior: Compress only existing contract gaps down to their floors; keep the minimum readable Hero ratio and camera touch target, and use FishCatchPager-local scrolling for any remaining height deficit.
vertical_allocation.footer_behavior: Keep Footer pinned in the safe content region and outside FishCatchPager scrolling.

illustrative_media.use: Hero, previous and next image content/cropping only; geometry is independent of image load status.
